title: Extract the Engram bootstrap fixture and tests out of src/tests/shared_codex.rs
outcome:
FOUND BY BOTH REVIEWERS INDEPENDENTLY (Codex session-6530 Low at :5527, Claude
session-6531 Low at :5526), which is why it is recorded despite being hygiene.

The 439 new test lines were appended to src/tests/shared_codex.rs, taking it
from 5,490 to 5,961 lines and past the project's roughly 5,000-line test-file
threshold - while the PRODUCTION code correctly received its own module,
src/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs.

EngramBootstrapFixture and the six engram_bootstrap_* tests are self-contained
and have an obvious home matching the existing per-topic convention
(codex_threads.rs, codex_home.rs, engram_host_adapter.rs): a new
src/tests/codex_engram_bootstrap.rs registered in src/tests/mod.rs, mirroring
the production module. Only the three edits to pre-existing tests and the shared
finish_engram_config_for_test helper need to stay reachable from
shared_codex.rs.
